examples.target: 你可以加上一件簡單的時尚配飾來提升你的造型。

examples.source: The designer showed her new fashion collection at the show.
examples.target: 設計師在時裝展上展示了她的新時裝系列。

examples.source: I really like the colors in this summer fashion collection.
examples.target: 我非常喜歡這個夏季時裝系列的配色。

examples.source: When the fashion collection was released, it sold out quickly.
examples.target: 當這個時裝系列推出時，很快就售罄了。

examples.source: She wants to work in the fashion industry after she graduates.
examples.target: 她畢業後想在時裝業工作。

examples.source: The fashion industry changes quickly because trends are always new.
examples.target: 因為潮流總是推陳出新，時裝業變化得很快。

examples.source: Many young designers hope to join the fashion industry one day.
examples.target: 許多年輕設計師都希望有朝一日能加入時裝業。

examples.source: The designer launched a new fashion line for the summer.
examples.target: 那位設計師為夏天推出了一個新的時裝系列。

examples.source: She wants to create a fashion line that is affordable.
examples.target: 她想創作一個價格相宜的時裝系列。

examples.source: This fashion line is very popular because the clothes are comfortable.
examples.target: 這個時裝系列非常受歡迎，因為衣服穿起來很舒適。

fashion sense.meaning: 時尚觸覺 / 衣著品味

examples.source: She has a great fashion sense and always looks stylish.
examples.target: 她有很好的時尚觸覺，看起來總是很有型。

examples.source: My brother is improving his fashion sense by reading magazines.
examples.target: 我哥哥正在透過閱讀雜誌來提升他的衣著品味。

examples.source: If you want a better fashion sense, try matching different colors.
examples.target: 如果你想有更好的衣著品味，試試配搭不同的顏色。

examples.source: Many teenagers like fast fashion because the clothes are very cheap.
examples.target: 很多青少年都喜歡快時尚，因為那些衣服非常便宜。

examples.source: Fast fashion is popular, but it creates a lot of waste.
examples.target: 快時尚雖然很受歡迎，但會造成很多浪費。

examples.source: If you buy fast fashion, you should try to wear it longer.
examples.target: 如果你購買快時尚產品，應該嘗試穿久一點。

fast forward.meaning: 快轉到 / 跳到較後時間

examples.source: You can fast forward the video to skip the long intro.
examples.target: 你可以快轉影片，跳過那段冗長的開場。

examples.source: I fast forwarded to the end because the movie was boring.
examples.target: 因為這部電影很無聊，所以我快轉到了結尾。

examples.source: Please fast forward if you want to see the main part.
examples.target: 如果你想看重點部分，請直接快轉。

examples.source: Life in Hong Kong has a very fast pace.
examples.target: 香港的生活節奏非常快。

examples.source: I find it hard to keep up with the fast pace of city life.
examples.target: 我覺得很難跟上城市生活的快速節奏。

examples.source: The fast pace of the game makes it very exciting to watch.
examples.target: 這場比賽的快速節奏令它看起來非常刺激。

examples.source: Please turn off the faucet after you wash your hands.
examples.target: 洗完手後，請記得關上水龍頭。

examples.source: The faucet is leaking, so we need to fix it.
examples.target: 水龍頭正在漏水，所以我們需要修理它。

examples.source: If you cannot turn the faucet, please ask for help.
examples.target: 如果你扭不開水龍頭，請找人幫忙。

faulty.meaning: 有問題的 / 有故障的

examples.source: The computer is faulty, so I cannot finish my homework.
examples.target: 這台電腦有故障，所以我無法完成功課。

examples.source: We returned the faulty toy to the shop yesterday.
examples.target: 我們昨天把那個有問題的玩具退回給商店。

examples.source: If you find a faulty product, please ask for a refund.
examples.target: 如果你發現產品有問題，請要求退款。

feature article.meaning: 專題文章 / 特寫文章

examples.source: The student wrote a feature article about local street food.
examples.target: 那位學生寫了一篇關於本地街頭小食的專題文章。

examples.source: I read a feature article in the newspaper this morning.
examples.target: 我今天早上看報紙時，讀了一篇專題文章。

examples.source: Our teacher asked us to write a feature article for school.
examples.target: 老師要求我們為學校寫一篇特寫文章。

examples.source: I am fed up of doing the same homework every day.
examples.target: 我對每天做同樣的功課感到厭倦。

examples.source: She is fed up of waiting for the bus in the rain.
examples.target: 她受夠了在雨中等巴士。

examples.source: We are fed up of listening to his boring stories.
examples.target: 我們對聽他那些沉悶的故事感到厭煩。

examples.source: Please leave your comments in the feedback section below.
examples.target: 請在下方的意見區留下你的評論。

examples.source: I checked the feedback section to see what students thought.
examples.target: 我查看了意見區，看看學生們有什麼想法。

examples.source: You can find the feedback section at the end of the form.
examples.target: 你可以在表格的末尾找到意見區。

feedback summary.meaning: 意見摘要 / 回饋摘要

examples.source: The teacher gave us a feedback summary after the presentation.
examples.target: 老師在報告結束後給了我們一份意見摘要。

examples.source: Please read the feedback summary if you want to improve.
examples.target: 如果你想進步，請閱讀這份回饋摘要。

examples.source: I wrote a feedback summary because the meeting was long.
examples.target: 因為會議很長，所以我寫了一份意見摘要。

feel at ease.meaning: 感到安心 / 感到自在

examples.source: I always feel at ease when I am with my best friends.
examples.target: 當我和最好的朋友在一起時，我總是感到很自在。

examples.source: The teacher's kind words helped the new student feel at ease.
examples.target: 老師親切的話語讓那位新同學感到安心。

examples.source: You should feel at ease because you have prepared well for it.
examples.target: 你應該感到安心，因為你已經為此做好了充分準備。

feel at home.meaning: 感到自在 / 有賓至如歸的感覺

examples.source: My host family made me feel at home during my stay.
examples.target: 在我留宿期間，寄宿家庭讓我感到賓至如歸。

examples.source: I feel at home whenever I visit my grandparents' house.
examples.target: 每當我到祖父母家時，我都感到非常自在。

examples.source: The friendly staff helped the new students feel at home.
examples.target: 友善的職員幫助新生們適應環境，讓他們感到自在。

examples.source: I feel awkward when I have to speak in front of everyone.
examples.target: 當我要在眾人面前說話時，我感到很尷尬。

examples.source: He felt awkward because he forgot his friend's name at the party.
examples.target: 他在派對上忘記了朋友的名字，所以感到很尷尬。

examples.source: It is normal to feel awkward when you meet someone for the first time.
examples.target: 第一次見面時感到尷尬是很正常的。

feel blue.meaning: 感到憂鬱 / 心情低落

examples.source: I always feel blue when it rains for many days.
examples.target: 當連續下幾天雨時，我總是感到心情低落。

examples.source: She felt blue because she failed her English test today.
examples.target: 她因為今天英文測驗不及格而感到憂鬱。

examples.source: Do not feel blue if you cannot finish the homework.
examples.target: 如果你做不完功課，也不用感到心情低落。

feel left out.meaning: 感到被冷落 / 被排除在外

examples.source: I feel left out when my friends talk about the party.
examples.target: 當朋友們談論派對時，我感到被冷落。

examples.source: Don't leave him alone, or he will feel left out.
examples.target: 不要讓他獨自一人，否則他會感到被冷落。

examples.source: She felt left out because she was not invited today.
examples.target: 因為今天沒有被邀請，她感到被排除在外。

feel rushed.meaning: 感覺太趕 / 感到倉促

examples.source: I always feel rushed when I have to finish my homework.
examples.target: 當我要完成功課時，我總是感到很倉促。

examples.source: Please start early so you do not feel rushed at school.
examples.target: 請早點開始，這樣你在學校就不會感到太趕。

examples.source: She felt rushed because she woke up late this morning.
examples.target: 因為今天早上遲起床，她感到很倉促。

examples.source: The small cat began to feel threatened by the large dog.
examples.target: 那隻小貓開始對那隻大狗感到受威脅。

examples.source: I feel threatened when people shout at me in class.
examples.target: 當有人在課室對我大吼大叫時，我會感到受威脅。

examples.source: She felt threatened because the stranger followed her for a while.
examples.target: 因為那個陌生人跟了她一會兒，她感到受威脅。

examples.source: Students feel valued when their teachers listen to their ideas.
examples.target: 當老師願意聆聽學生意見時，他們會感到被重視。

examples.source: I feel valued because my team always asks for my help.
examples.target: 因為團隊總是尋求我的協助，所以我感到被重視。

examples.source: Small acts of kindness make everyone feel valued at school.
examples.target: 小小的善舉能讓學校裡的每個人都感到被重視。

examples.source: He often has a feeling of loneliness when he is home alone.
examples.target: 當他獨自在家時，經常會有一種孤獨感。

examples.source: Moving to a new city gave her a strong feeling of loneliness.
examples.target: 搬到新城市讓她產生了一種強烈的孤獨感。

examples.source: I try to talk to friends to overcome my feeling of loneliness.
examples.target: 我嘗試與朋友交談，以克服我的孤獨感。

fellow player.meaning: 其他玩家 / 同伴玩家

examples.source: I always help my fellow player when they need items.
examples.target: 當我的同伴玩家需要道具時，我總會幫助他們。

examples.source: My fellow player taught me how to win the game.
examples.target: 我的同伴玩家教我如何贏得這場遊戲。

examples.source: We should be kind to every fellow player in the team.
examples.target: 我們應該對隊伍裡的每一位同伴玩家友善。

fellow skier.meaning: 另一名滑雪者 / 同行滑雪者

examples.source: I met a friendly fellow skier on the mountain today.
examples.target: 我今天在山上遇到了一位友善的同行滑雪者。

examples.source: My fellow skier helped me when I fell down.
examples.target: 當我跌倒時，我的同行滑雪者幫助了我。

examples.source: It is important to look out for every fellow skier.
examples.target: 照顧每一位同行滑雪者是很重要的。

examples.source: I enjoy playing basketball with every fellow teen in my class.
examples.target: 我喜歡和班上每一位同齡青少年一起打籃球。

examples.source: It is easier to talk to a fellow teen about school problems.
examples.target: 和同齡青少年談論學校的問題會比較容易。

examples.source: Every fellow teen should learn how to use the internet safely.
examples.target: 每一位同齡青少年都應該學會如何安全地使用互聯網。

examples.source: She wants to be a professional female footballer when she grows up.
examples.target: 她長大後想成為一名職業女子足球員。

examples.source: The female footballer scored a goal for her team yesterday.
examples.target: 那位女子足球員昨天為她的球隊射入了一球。

examples.target: 許多小女孩都夢想成為著名的女子足球員。

examples.source: The workers will fence off the area for our safety.
examples.target: 工人們會為了我們的安全，把那個區域圍起來。

examples.source: They had to fence off the garden to keep dogs out.
examples.target: 他們必須把花園圍起來，以防止狗隻進入。

examples.target: 在小朋友玩耍之前，請先將工地圍起來。

examples.source: Please do not enter the fenced-off area near the construction site.
examples.target: 請不要進入建築工地附近的圍欄圍起區域。

examples.source: We saw some cute rabbits inside the fenced-off area at the park.
examples.target: 我們在公園的圍欄圍起區域內看到幾隻可愛的兔子。

examples.source: The workers cleaned the fenced-off area after they finished the job.
examples.target: 工人們完成工作後，清理了那個圍欄圍起的區域。

examples.source: The young fencer practiced hard to win the school competition.
examples.target: 這位年輕的劍擊運動員努力練習，希望能贏得校際比賽。

examples.source: My sister is a talented fencer who trains every weekend.
examples.target: 我姐姐是一位很有天賦的劍擊運動員，她每個週末都會訓練。

examples.source: When the fencer wears her mask, she looks very professional.
examples.target: 當這位劍擊運動員戴上頭罩時，她看起來非常專業。

examples.source: The feng shui master checked the house for good energy.
examples.target: 那位風水師檢查了這間屋子的運勢。

examples.source: My family invited a feng shui master to visit our home.
examples.target: 我家人邀請了一位風水師到訪我們的家。

examples.source: If you want to move, ask a feng shui master first.
examples.target: 如果你想搬屋，先問問風水師的意見。

festival of colours.meaning: 色彩節 / 灑紅節別稱

examples.source: People throw coloured powder during the festival of colours.
examples.target: 人們在色彩節期間會互相拋灑彩色粉末。

examples.source: I want to visit India for the festival of colours.
examples.target: 我想去印度參加色彩節。

examples.source: Everyone is very happy at the festival of colours.
examples.target: 每個人在色彩節時都感到非常快樂。

examples.target: 為了迎接節日，街道上都裝飾了喜慶的燈飾。

examples.target: 我們去親戚家吃晚飯時，都穿上了節日氣氛的衣服。

examples.target: 音樂會期間，禮堂裡充滿了喜慶的氣氛。

examples.target: 我喜歡在睡前閱讀一個精彩的虛構故事。

examples.source: The book is just a fictional story, so it is not real.
examples.target: 這本書只是一個虛構故事，所以內容並非真實。

examples.source: She wrote a short fictional story for her English homework assignment.
examples.target: 她為英文功課寫了一個簡短的虛構故事。

examples.source: I love reading books about a magical fictional world.
examples.target: 我喜歡閱讀關於魔法虛構世界的書。

examples.source: The author created a detailed fictional world in his novel.
examples.target: 作者在他的小說中創造了一個詳細的虛構世界。

examples.source: It is fun to imagine living in a fictional world.
examples.target: 想像自己生活在一個虛構世界中很有趣。

fifa world cup.meaning: 國際足協世界盃 / 世界盃

examples.source: Many people watch the FIFA World Cup on television every four years.
examples.target: 每隔四年，很多人都會在電視上觀看國際足協世界盃。

examples.source: I feel very excited when the FIFA World Cup starts this summer.
examples.target: 當今年夏天國際足協世界盃開始時，我感到很興奮。

examples.source: My brother likes the FIFA World Cup because he loves playing football.
examples.target: 我哥哥喜歡國際足協世界盃，因為他很喜歡踢足球。

examples.source: We can see the whole city from that fifty-story building.
examples.target: 我們從那棟五十層高的建築物可以看到整個城市。

examples.source: The fifty-story hotel is the tallest building in this area.
examples.target: 這間五十層高的酒店是這一區最高的建築物。

examples.source: It takes a long time to reach the fifty-story office.
examples.target: 要到達那間五十層高的辦公室需要很長時間。

examples.source: Our team tried to fight back after losing the first half.
examples.target: 我們隊在上半場落後後，嘗試反擊。

examples.source: If someone bullies you, fight back by telling a trusted adult.
examples.target: 如果有人欺負你，應該向可信任的成年人求助來反擊。

examples.source: Our team started to fight back after losing the first game.
examples.target: 我們隊在輸掉第一場比賽後，開始奮力反擊。

examples.source: The fight scene in this movie is very exciting to watch.
examples.target: 這部電影裡的打鬥場面非常精彩。

examples.source: I closed my eyes during the long fight scene in the film.
examples.target: 電影裡那段漫長的打鬥場面，我嚇得閉上了眼睛。

examples.source: The actors practiced for weeks to film the difficult fight scene.
examples.target: 演員們練習了好幾個星期，才拍好那個高難度的打鬥場面。

examples.source: The brave fighter protected the village from the heavy storm.
examples.target: 那位勇敢的戰士保護村莊免受暴風雨侵襲。

examples.source: The pilot flew the fighter jet high above the blue clouds.
examples.target: 飛行員駕駛戰鬥機在藍天之上高空飛行。

examples.source: She is a real fighter because she never gives up easily.
examples.target: 她是一位真正的戰士，因為她從不輕言放棄。

examples.source: Please complete the fill-in-the-blank exercise in your workbook.
examples.target: 請完成練習冊裡的填充題。

examples.source: The teacher gave us a fill-in-the-blank test this morning.
examples.target: 老師今天早上給了我們一份填空測驗。

examples.source: I find fill-in-the-blank questions easier than writing long essays.
examples.target: 我覺得填充題比寫長篇文章容易。

examples.source: I prefer the book more than the film adaptation.
examples.target: 比起電影改編作品，我更喜歡原著小說。

examples.source: The film adaptation is very different from the original story.
examples.target: 這部電影改編作品與原著故事有很大分別。

examples.source: I watched the film adaptation after I finished reading the book.
examples.target: 我看完那本書後，就去看了這部電影改編作品。

examples.source: The film crew is setting up cameras for the new movie.
examples.target: 電影製作團隊正在為新電影架設攝影機。

examples.source: We saw the film crew working hard on the street today.
examples.target: 我們今天看到電影製作團隊在街上努力工作。

examples.source: If the film crew arrives early, we can start filming sooner.
examples.target: 如果電影製作團隊早點到達，我們就能更快開始拍攝。

film equipment.meaning: 拍攝器材 / 電影製作器材

examples.source: The students rented some film equipment to make a short movie.
examples.target: 學生們租了一些拍攝器材來製作短片。

examples.source: We need to pack all the film equipment before we leave.
examples.target: 我們離開前需要把所有拍攝器材收拾好。

examples.source: He learned how to use the film equipment during the workshop.
examples.target: 他在工作坊期間學會了如何使用這些拍攝器材。

examples.source: We watched many interesting movies at the film festival yesterday.
examples.target: 我們昨天在電影節看了很多有趣的電影。

examples.source: My sister wants to go to the film festival this weekend.
examples.target: 我姐姐想在這個週末去電影節。

examples.source: If you like movies, you should visit the film festival.
examples.target: 如果你喜歡電影，你應該去參觀電影節。

examples.source: My favorite film genre is comedy because it makes me laugh.
examples.target: 我最喜歡的電影類型是喜劇，因為它能讓我大笑。

examples.source: When choosing a film genre, I usually prefer watching action movies.
examples.target: 當選擇電影類型時，我通常比較喜歡看動作片。

examples.source: Science fiction is a popular film genre among secondary school students.
examples.target: 科幻片是中學生之間很受歡迎的電影類型。

examples.source: Many young people want to work in the film industry.
examples.target: 很多年輕人都想投身電影業。

examples.source: She studied hard because she loves the film industry.
examples.target: 她努力學習，因為她熱愛電影業。

examples.source: If you join the film industry, you can meet many actors.
examples.target: 如果你加入電影業，你就可以見到很多演員。

film library.meaning: 電影資料庫 / 影片收藏庫

examples.source: Our school has a film library for students to borrow movies.
examples.target: 我們學校有一個電影資料庫，讓學生可以借閱影片。

examples.source: I visited the film library to find some old classic movies.
examples.target: 我去了電影資料庫，想找一些經典的老電影。

examples.source: The film library is a great place to study cinema history.
examples.target: 電影資料庫是一個學習電影歷史的好地方。

film podcast.meaning: 電影播客 / 電影 podcast 節目

examples.source: I listen to a film podcast when I commute to school.
examples.target: 我上學途中會聽電影播客。

examples.source: They discuss new movies on their weekly film podcast.
examples.target: 他們在每週的電影播客中討論新電影。

examples.source: If you love cinema, you should try this film podcast.

examples.source: We learned about the local fishing activity during our school trip.
examples.target: 我們在學校旅行時認識了當地的捕魚活動。

examples.source: The fishing activity is popular when the weather is sunny.
examples.target: 天氣晴朗時，捕魚活動非常受歡迎。

examples.source: Aberdeen is a famous fishing port in Hong Kong.
examples.target: 香港仔是一個著名的香港漁港。

examples.source: Many boats return to the fishing port when it rains.
examples.target: 下雨時，許多船隻都會回到漁港。

examples.source: We visited the busy fishing port to buy fresh fish.
examples.target: 我們到那個繁忙的漁港購買新鮮魚類。

examples.source: The fishing vessel returned to the harbour with many fresh fish.
examples.target: 那艘漁船帶著許多鮮魚回到了港口。

examples.source: We saw a large fishing vessel sailing across the blue sea.
examples.target: 我們看見一艘大型漁船航行在藍色的海上。

examples.source: The fishing vessel stayed at sea because the weather was good.
examples.target: 因為天氣很好，那艘漁船便留在海上作業。

fit in.meaning: 安排時間做 / 擠出時間做

examples.source: I will try to fit in a quick run after school.
examples.target: 放學後，我會嘗試擠出時間去跑一會步。

examples.source: Can you fit in a meeting with me this afternoon?
examples.target: 你今天下午可以安排時間跟我開個會嗎？

examples.source: She fits in piano lessons whenever she has free time.
examples.target: 她一有空閒時間，就會安排去上鋼琴課。

examples.source: He finds it hard to fit in at his new school.
examples.target: 他在新學校覺得很難融入。

examples.source: I try to fit in when I meet new friends.
examples.target: 當我結識新朋友時，我會嘗試合群一點。

examples.source: She feels like she does not fit in with this group.
examples.target: 她覺得自己無法融入這個群體。

examples.source: The new timetable does not fit in with our lesson plan.
examples.target: 新的時間表與我們的課堂計劃不太配合。

examples.source: Does this new sofa fit in with our living room?
examples.target: 這張新梳化跟我們的客廳風格合襯嗎？

examples.source: This simple design fits in with the rest of the classroom.
examples.target: 這個簡單設計與課室其他部分很配合。

examples.source: I can fit the piano lesson into the timetable on Saturday.
examples.target: 我可以把鋼琴課安排入星期六的時間表。

examples.source: It is hard to fit all these activities into the timetable.
examples.target: 要把所有這些活動安排入時間表是很困難的。

examples.source: Can you fit our group meeting into the timetable for tomorrow?
examples.target: 你可以把我們的小組會議安排入明天的時間表嗎？

examples.source: I choose this sport because it fits my lifestyle well.
examples.target: 我選擇這項運動，因為它很適合我的生活方式。

examples.source: This flexible job fits my lifestyle, so I am happy.
examples.target: 這份彈性的工作很適合我的生活方式，所以我很開心。

examples.source: If you want to stay healthy, find a diet that fits your lifestyle.
examples.target: 如果你想保持健康，就找一個適合你生活方式的飲食習慣。

examples.source: This new laptop does not fit within my budget.
examples.target: 這部新手提電腦並不符合我的預算。

examples.source: We chose a cheaper hotel to fit within our budget.
examples.target: 我們選擇了一間較便宜的酒店，以符合我們的預算。

examples.source: If you want to fit within your budget, buy fewer snacks.
examples.target: 如果你想符合預算，就買少一點零食吧。

examples.source: I joined a fitness camp to get healthier this summer.
examples.target: 我今年夏天參加了一個健身訓練營，希望變得更健康。

examples.source: The fitness camp helps students build strength and confidence.
examples.target: 這個健身訓練營能幫助學生建立力量和自信。

examples.source: If you want to exercise more safely, you can try a fitness camp.
examples.target: 如果你想更安全地做運動，可以嘗試參加健身訓練營。

examples.source: My fitness coach helps me exercise safely at the gym.
examples.target: 我的健身教練幫助我在健身房安全地運動。

examples.source: You should ask a fitness coach before trying a new exercise plan.
examples.target: 嘗試新的運動計劃前，你應該請教健身教練。

examples.source: The fitness coach showed us how to use the machines correctly.
examples.target: 健身教練示範了如何正確使用這些健身器材。

examples.source: Our school has a new fitness facility for students to use.
examples.target: 我們學校有一個新的健身設施供學生使用。

examples.source: I go to the fitness facility every day to stay healthy.
examples.target: 我每天都去健身設施鍛煉，以保持健康。

examples.source: The fitness facility is closed because they are cleaning the room.
examples.target: 因為正在清潔房間，所以健身設施暫時關閉。

examples.source: My sister works as a fitness instructor at the local gym.
examples.target: 我姐姐在當地的健身中心擔任健身教練。

examples.source: The fitness instructor showed us how to exercise safely today.
examples.target: 健身教練今天示範了我們如何安全地運動。

examples.source: If you want to get stronger, ask a fitness instructor for help.
examples.target: 如果你想變得更強壯，可以向健身教練尋求協助。

examples.source: You should check the five ws before you start writing stories.
examples.target: 在你開始寫故事之前，應該先檢查一下五個 W 要素。

examples.source: The five ws help us understand the main points of news.
examples.target: 五個 W 要素能幫助我們理解新聞的重點。

examples.source: Please use the five ws if you want to write clearly.
examples.target: 如果你想寫得清楚，請運用五個 W 要素。

examples.source: My father likes having a five-day working week.
examples.target: 我爸爸很喜歡五天工作週。

examples.source: We enjoy a five-day working week because we have more rest.
examples.target: 我們享受五天工作週，因為我們有更多休息時間。

examples.source: If the company has a five-day working week, staff will be happier.
examples.target: 如果公司實行五天工作週，員工會更開心。

examples.source: Use a fixed amount of flour for this cake recipe.
examples.target: 這個蛋糕食譜要使用固定數量的麵粉。

examples.source: The teacher gives each group a fixed amount of paper.
examples.target: 老師給每組固定數量的紙張。

examples.source: Each student should add a fixed amount of water to the cup.
examples.target: 每位學生都應在杯中加入固定數量的水。

examples.source: My father works fixed hours at the office every day.
examples.target: 我爸爸每天都在辦公室有固定的工作時間。

examples.source: She prefers a job with fixed hours to help her plan.
examples.target: 她比較喜歡有固定工作時間的職位，方便她作計劃。

examples.source: Most shop assistants do not have fixed hours of work.
examples.target: 大部分店務助理都沒有固定的工作時間。

examples.source: The heavy desk is fixed in one place in the classroom.
examples.target: 這張沉重的書桌固定在課室裡的一個位置。

examples.source: This lamp is fixed in one place so it cannot move.
examples.target: 這盞燈固定在一個地方，所以它不能移動。

examples.source: The basketball hoop is fixed in one place on the wall.
examples.target: 籃球架固定在牆上的一個位置。

examples.source: I like to drink fizzy soda when the weather is hot.
examples.target: 天氣熱的時候，我喜歡喝有氣汽水。

examples.source: This fizzy drink tastes like fresh lemon and sweet honey.
examples.target: 這款有氣飲品喝起來有新鮮檸檬和甜蜂蜜的味道。

examples.source: The water became fizzy after I added a vitamin tablet.
examples.target: 我加入維他命片後，水就開始起泡了。

examples.source: We helped with the flag day collection to raise money for charity.
examples.target: 我們幫忙參與賣旗籌款，為慈善機構籌集資金。

examples.source: I bought a sticker during the flag day collection this morning.
examples.target: 我今早參與賣旗籌款時買了一張貼紙。

examples.source: Many students volunteered for the flag day collection on Saturday.
examples.target: 許多學生在星期六自願參與賣旗籌款。

examples.source: I love eating egg tarts because they have a delicious flaky pastry.
examples.target: 我很喜歡吃蛋撻，因為它們有美味的酥皮。

examples.source: The bakery sells fresh bread and cakes with a light flaky pastry.
examples.target: 這間麵包店售賣新鮮麵包和口感鬆化的酥皮蛋糕。

examples.source: If you want a tasty snack, try this pie with flaky pastry.
examples.target: 如果你想吃小食，可以試試這個有酥皮的餡餅。

examples.source: The bird began to flap its wings before it flew away.
examples.target: 那隻鳥在飛走前開始拍動翅膀。

examples.source: You can see the butterfly flap its wings in the garden.
examples.target: 你可以看見蝴蝶在花園裡拍動翅膀。

examples.source: The baby bird tried to flap its wings to stay balanced.
examples.target: 那隻幼鳥嘗試拍動翅膀來保持平衡。

examples.source: I always bring a flask of hot water to school.
examples.target: 我每天都會帶一個保溫瓶回學校。

examples.source: Please put your flask in your bag after drinking.
examples.target: 飲完水之後，請將你的水壺放回書包。

examples.source: My flask keeps my tea warm during the winter.
examples.target: 冬天時，我的保溫瓶能讓茶保持溫暖。

examples.source: It is easier to build a house on flat land.
examples.target: 在平地上建房子會比較容易。

examples.source: We walked across the flat land to reach the village.
examples.target: 我們走過那片平地，終於到達了村莊。

examples.source: Farmers prefer to grow crops on flat land.
examples.target: 農夫比較喜歡在平地上種植農作物。

examples.source: We were late for school because we had a flat tire.
examples.target: 因為車胎爆了，我們上學遲到了。

examples.source: My father stopped the car when he got a flat tire.
examples.target: 當爸爸發現車胎爆了，他便把車停下來。

examples.source: If you have a flat tire, you should call for help.
examples.target: 如果你遇到車胎爆了的情況，應該打電話求助。

flat-screen monitor.meaning: 平面顯示屏 / 平面螢幕

examples.source: I bought a new flat-screen monitor for my computer today.
examples.target: 我今天為電腦買了一個新的平面顯示屏。

examples.source: A flat-screen monitor takes up less space on my desk.
examples.target: 平面顯示屏在我書桌上佔用的空間較少。

examples.source: My eyes feel better when I use a large flat-screen monitor.
examples.target: 當我使用大型平面顯示屏時，我的眼睛感覺舒服一點。

flatmate.meaning: 同屋住的人 / 合租室友

examples.source: My flatmate and I share the kitchen chores every week.
examples.target: 我和我的合租室友每星期會分擔廚房的家務。

examples.source: I am looking for a new flatmate to share the rent.
examples.target: 我正在尋找一位新室友來分擔租金。

examples.source: My flatmate is very tidy, so our living room is clean.
examples.target: 我的合租室友非常整潔，所以我們的客廳很乾淨。

flavour combination.meaning: 味道配搭 / 口味組合

examples.source: This chocolate and mint flavour combination is my favourite.
examples.target: 這個朱古力配薄荷的味道配搭是我的最愛。

examples.source: The chef created a unique flavour combination for the dessert.
examples.target: 廚師為這款甜品設計了一種獨特的口味組合。

examples.source: I like this flavour combination because it tastes very fresh.
examples.target: 我喜歡這個味道配搭，因為它吃起來很清新。

examples.source: I prefer drinking plain water instead of flavoured drinks.
examples.target: 比起加味飲品，我更喜歡喝清水。

examples.source: This shop sells many different flavoured popcorns for customers.
examples.target: 這家店為顧客售賣多種不同味道的爆谷。

examples.source: My sister bought some strawberry flavoured biscuits for me.
examples.target: 我姐姐買了一些士多啤梨味的餅乾給我。

examples.source: I prefer drinking strawberry flavoured milk for my breakfast.
examples.target: 我早餐比較喜歡喝士多啤梨調味奶。

examples.source: My mother buys flavoured milk when it is on sale.
examples.target: 當調味奶減價時，我媽媽會買一些。

examples.source: Chocolate flavoured milk is very popular among secondary school students.
examples.target: 朱古力調味奶在中學生之間非常受歡迎。

examples.source: The villagers had to flee to the mountains when the storm started.
examples.target: 當風暴開始時，村民們必須逃往山上。

examples.source: The family had to flee to the countryside during the flood.
examples.target: 洪水期間，這家人不得不逃往鄉郊。

examples.source: The small rabbit managed to flee to safety when the dog arrived.
examples.target: 當小狗出現時，那隻小兔子成功逃到了安全的地方。

examples.source: I like to flick through magazines while waiting for the bus.
examples.target: 我喜歡在等巴士的時候快速翻閱雜誌。

examples.source: She flicked through the book to find the answer quickly.
examples.target: 她快速翻閱那本書，想盡快找到答案。

examples.source: If you flick through these notes, you will remember the main points.
examples.target: 如果你快速翻閱這些筆記，你就會記得重點。

examples.source: I picked up a flier about the new library opening.
examples.target: 我拿了一張關於新圖書館開幕的傳單。

examples.source: She handed out a flier to everyone at the school gate.
examples.target: 她在校門口向每個人派發傳單。

examples.source: Please read the flier if you want to join the club.
examples.target: 如果你想參加這個學會，請看看這張傳單。

examples.source: The flight attendant served us drinks during the long flight.
examples.target: 空中服務員在長途飛行期間為我們送上飲品。

examples.source: I want to be a flight attendant when I grow up.
examples.target: 我長大後想成為一名空中服務員。

examples.source: The flight attendant helped the passenger because he felt sick.
examples.target: 因為那位乘客感到不適，空中服務員便上前幫忙。

examples.source: He walked up the flight of stairs to reach his classroom.
examples.target: 他走上一段樓梯去課室。

examples.source: Please be careful when you walk down that flight of stairs.
examples.target: 當你走下那段樓梯時，請小心一點。

examples.source: There is a long flight of stairs outside the school library.
examples.target: 學校圖書館外面有一段很長的樓梯。

examples.source: My grandfather still uses a flip phone to call us.
examples.target: 我爺爺仍然用一部揭蓋手機打電話給我們。

examples.source: She bought a new flip phone because it is simple.
examples.target: 她買了一部新摺機，因為它用起來很簡單。

examples.source: It is fun when you close your flip phone after talking.
examples.target: 講完電話後把摺機合上，感覺很有趣。

examples.source: I saw some floating leaves on the surface of the lake.
examples.target: 我看見湖面上有一些漂浮的葉子。

examples.source: The astronaut felt like he was floating in outer space.
examples.target: 那位太空人感覺自己好像在外太空漂浮一樣。

examples.source: We used a floating toy to help the child swim safely.
examples.target: 我們用了一個浮動玩具來幫助孩子安全地游泳。

floating school.meaning: 空中學校 / 漂浮學校

examples.source: The children take a boat to reach their floating school.
examples.target: 孩子們乘船前往他們的漂浮學校。

examples.source: Life on a floating school is very different from ours.
examples.target: 漂浮學校的生活跟我們的很不一樣。

examples.source: They study in a floating school because they live nearby.
examples.target: 因為住在附近，他們都在那間漂浮學校上課。

examples.source: The living room has a large floor-to-ceiling window.
examples.target: 客廳有一扇很大的落地玻璃窗。

examples.source: We enjoy the view from our floor-to-ceiling window.
examples.target: 我們很喜歡從落地玻璃窗看出去的風景。

examples.source: The sun shines through the floor-to-ceiling window every morning.
examples.target: 每天早上陽光都會透過落地玻璃窗照進來。

examples.source: We play floorball in the school hall every Friday afternoon.
examples.target: 我們每個星期五下午都會在學校禮堂打地板曲棍球。

examples.source: Floorball is a fast game because you must run quickly.
examples.target: 地板曲棍球是一項節奏很快的運動，因為你必須跑得很快。

examples.source: If you want to join the floorball team, please sign up.
examples.target: 如果你想加入地板曲棍球隊，請記得報名。

examples.source: The architect showed us the floorplan of our new house.
examples.target: 建築師向我們展示了新屋的平面圖。

examples.source: We studied the floorplan to see where the rooms are.
examples.target: 我們研究了平面圖，看看房間位於哪裡。

examples.source: If you look at the floorplan, you can find the exit.
examples.target: 如果你看一看平面圖，就能找到出口。

examples.source: Please draw a flowchart to show the steps of the project.
examples.target: 請畫一張流程圖來展示項目的步驟。

examples.source: I followed the flowchart to fix the computer problem easily.
examples.target: 我按照流程圖的指示，輕鬆地解決了電腦問題。

examples.source: The teacher used a flowchart to explain how the system works.
examples.target: 老師用一張流程圖來解釋這個系統是如何運作的。

examples.source: My mother enjoys flower arranging in her free time.
examples.target: 我媽媽在空閒時很喜歡插花。

examples.source: We learned flower arranging at the community centre today.
examples.target: 我們今天在社區中心學習插花。

examples.source: She likes flower arranging because it makes her feel calm.
examples.target: 她喜歡插花，因為這讓她感到平靜。

examples.source: The gardener is planting red roses in the flowerbed.
examples.target: 園丁正在花圃裡種植紅玫瑰。

examples.source: Please do not step on the flowers in the flowerbed.
examples.target: 請不要踩到花圃裡的花。

examples.source: We cleaned the flowerbed because it was full of weeds.
examples.target: 我們清理了花圃，因為裡面長滿了雜草。

examples.source: You should stay home if you have any flu-like symptom.
examples.target: 如果你有任何類似流感的症狀，就應該留在家中。

examples.source: She felt tired and had a flu-like symptom this morning.
examples.target: 她今早感到疲倦，並且出現了類似流感的症狀。

examples.source: Please see a doctor when you develop a flu-like symptom.
examples.target: 當你出現類似流感的症狀時，請去看醫生。

examples.source: She can speak English fluently because she lived in London.
examples.target: 因為她曾經住在倫敦，所以她能流利地說英語。

examples.source: You will speak Cantonese fluently if you practice every day.
examples.target: 如果你每天練習，你就能流利地說廣東話。

examples.source: He reads the story aloud fluently to his younger brother.
examples.target: 他流利地為弟弟朗讀那個故事。

examples.source: The fluorescent light in our classroom flickered for a while.
examples.target: 課室裡的螢光燈閃爍了一陣子。

examples.source: Please turn off the fluorescent light when you leave the room.
examples.target: 離開房間時，請記得關掉螢光燈。

examples.source: I cannot study well because the fluorescent light is too dim.
examples.target: 因為螢光燈太暗，我無法專心讀書。

examples.source: The butterfly began to flutter its wings when it landed on the flower.
examples.target: 當蝴蝶停在花朵上時，牠開始拍動翅膀。

examples.source: I watched the small bird flutter its wings before it flew away quickly.
examples.target: 我看着那隻小鳥在迅速飛走前拍動翅膀。

examples.source: The parrot will flutter its wings if it feels excited to see you.
examples.target: 如果鸚鵡見到你感到興奮，牠就會拍動翅膀。

examples.source: The club arranged flyer distribution for the charity event.
examples.target: 學會為慈善活動安排了派發傳單工作。

examples.source: Flyer distribution helped more students learn about the fair.
examples.target: 派發傳單讓更多學生知道這個市集。

examples.source: We finished the flyer distribution outside the community centre.
examples.target: 我們在社區中心外完成了派發傳單工作。

examples.source: The flyer distributor handed me a coupon for a new restaurant.
examples.target: 派傳單員遞給我一張新餐廳的優惠券。

examples.source: I saw a flyer distributor working hard outside the busy station.
examples.target: 我看見一位派傳單員在繁忙的車站外努力工作。

examples.source: If you see a flyer distributor, please take one to help them.
examples.target: 如果你見到派傳單員，請拿一張傳單來幫助他們。

examples.source: The boy looked at the sky and saw a flying saucer.
examples.target: 那個男孩望向天空，看見了一隻飛碟。

examples.source: Some people believe that a flying saucer visited the park.
examples.target: 有些人相信曾經有一隻飛碟到訪過公園。

examples.source: If you see a flying saucer, please take a photo.
examples.target: 如果你見到飛碟，請拍一張照片。

examples.source: She stayed focussed on her homework until she finished it.
examples.target: 她一直專注於做功課，直到完成為止。

examples.source: You need to be more focussed when you study for exams.

examples.source: If you arrive early, you can get a special free giveaway.
examples.target: 如果你早點到達，就可以獲得一份特別的贈品。

examples.source: The government provides a free school lunch for every student.
examples.target: 政府為每位學生提供免費校餐。

examples.source: Students can enjoy a free school lunch if they apply early.
examples.target: 如果學生提早申請，就可以享用免費校餐。

examples.source: We are happy because the school offers a free school lunch.
examples.target: 因為學校提供免費校餐，所以我們都很開心。

free session.meaning: 免費課節 / 免費體驗

examples.source: You can join a free session to learn how to play tennis.
examples.target: 你可以參加一個免費課節，學習如何打網球。

examples.source: We offer a free session if you want to try our gym.
examples.target: 如果你想試用我們的健身室，我們提供一個免費體驗。

examples.source: Please sign up for the free session before the class starts.
examples.target: 請在課堂開始前報名參加這個免費課節。

examples.source: My sister works as a freelancer because she likes flexible hours.
examples.target: 我姐姐是一名自由工作者，因為她喜歡靈活的工作時間。

examples.source: It is hard to be a freelancer when you have no boss.
examples.target: 當你沒有老闆時，做一名自由工作者是很困難的。

examples.source: If you are a freelancer, you must manage your own time.
examples.target: 如果你是一名自由工作者，你必須管理好自己的時間。

examples.source: I like to swim freestyle because it is very fast.
examples.target: 我喜歡游自由泳，因為這種泳式速度很快。

examples.source: He won the race when he used the freestyle stroke.
examples.target: 他用了自由泳泳式，結果贏得了比賽。

examples.source: If you want to swim faster, you should learn freestyle.
examples.target: 如果你想游得更快，就應該學習自由泳。

examples.source: It is freezing cold outside, so please wear your thick coat.
examples.target: 外面天氣嚴寒，請穿上你的厚外套。

examples.source: We stayed indoors to avoid the freezing cold during the winter.
examples.target: 冬天時我們都留在室內，以避開嚴寒的天氣。

examples.source: If you go out in this freezing cold, you may feel unwell.
examples.target: 如果你在這種嚴寒天氣下外出，你可能會感到不適。

examples.source: We visited the French Concession when we traveled to Shanghai.
examples.target: 我們去上海旅行時，參觀了法租界。

examples.source: The French Concession has many beautiful old buildings and cafes.
examples.target: 法租界有很多漂亮的舊建築和咖啡店。

examples.source: If you like history, you should explore the French Concession.
examples.target: 如果你喜歡歷史，就應該去探索法租界。

examples.source: I bought a delicious French tart from the bakery today.
examples.target: 我今天從麵包店買了一個美味的法式撻。

examples.source: We can share a French tart if you are hungry.
examples.target: 如果你肚餓的話，我們可以分享一個法式撻。

examples.source: My mother made a sweet French tart for my birthday.
examples.target: 我媽媽為我的生日做了一個甜甜的法式撻。

examples.source: The bread is fresh out of the oven and smells delicious.
examples.target: 麵包剛出爐，聞起來非常香。

examples.source: We ate cookies that were fresh out of the oven.
examples.target: 我們吃了剛出爐的曲奇餅。

examples.source: I love eating pizza when it is fresh out of the oven.
examples.target: 我喜歡吃剛出爐的薄餅。

examples.source: The bread smells delicious because it was freshly baked.
examples.target: 這麵包聞起來很香，因為它是剛烤好的。

examples.source: I enjoy drinking freshly squeezed orange juice every morning.
examples.target: 我每天早上都喜歡喝鮮榨橙汁。

examples.source: The flowers look beautiful when they are freshly picked.
examples.target: 這些花剛摘下來的時候看起來很漂亮。

examples.source: I love the freshness of the vegetables from the local market.
examples.target: 我喜歡本地市場蔬菜的那種新鮮感。

examples.source: The morning air has a special freshness after the heavy rain.
examples.target: 大雨過後，清晨的空氣有一種特別的清新感。

examples.source: We should check the freshness of the milk before we drink.
examples.target: 我們飲用牛奶之前，應該先檢查它是否新鮮。

examples.source: The lake is an important freshwater source for the nearby village.
examples.target: 這個湖泊是附近村莊重要的淡水水源。

examples.source: We must protect every freshwater source to keep our water clean.
examples.target: 我們必須保護每一個淡水水源，以保持食水潔淨。

examples.source: If we pollute the river, we will lose a freshwater source.
examples.target: 如果我們污染這條河流，就會失去一個淡水水源。

examples.source: My grandmother often cooks fried dace with black beans for dinner.
examples.target: 我祖母晚餐時經常煮豆豉鯪魚。

examples.source: We like to eat fried dace with black beans with rice.
examples.target: 我們喜歡配白飯吃豆豉鯪魚。

examples.source: If you are hungry, try some fried dace with black beans.
examples.target: 如果你肚餓的話，試試吃點豆豉鯪魚吧。

examples.source: The loud noise gave the cat a sudden fright.
examples.target: 巨大的噪音令那隻貓嚇了一跳。

examples.source: I jumped in fright when the door opened suddenly.
examples.target: 當門突然打開時，我嚇得跳了起來。

examples.source: She turned pale with fright after seeing the spider.
examples.target: 她看到那隻蜘蛛後，嚇得臉色蒼白。

examples.source: We played with a frisbee at the park yesterday afternoon.
examples.target: 昨天下午我們在公園玩飛碟。

examples.source: My dog loves to catch the frisbee when I throw it.
examples.target: 當我拋出飛碟時，我的狗很喜歡去接住它。

examples.source: It is fun to throw a frisbee with your friends outside.
examples.target: 在戶外與朋友一起拋飛碟很有趣。

examples.source: The party continued from dusk until dawn at the beach.
examples.target: 派對在沙灘上由黃昏一直進行到黎明。

examples.source: They worked from dusk until dawn to finish the project.
examples.target: 他們由黃昏到黎明不停工作，為了完成這個項目。

examples.source: The lighthouse light shines from dusk until dawn every night.
examples.target: 燈塔的燈光每晚由黃昏到黎明都會亮著。

examples.source: From my perspective, this is the best way to study English.
examples.target: 從我的角度來看，這是學習英文最好的方法。

examples.source: From my perspective, we should finish the project before the weekend.
examples.target: 從我的角度來看，我們應該在週末前完成這個計劃。

examples.source: It is a good idea, but from my perspective, it is too expensive.
examples.target: 這是一個好主意，但從我的角度來看，它太昂貴了。

examples.source: The chicken is still frozen in the middle after cooking.
examples.target: 雞肉煮完之後，中間仍然是冰凍的。

examples.source: I cannot eat the pie because it is frozen in the middle.
examples.target: 我不能吃這個批，因為它中間仍然是冰凍的。

examples.source: The meat was frozen in the middle when I started frying it.
examples.target: 當我開始煎肉的時候，它中間仍然是冰凍的。

examples.source: A fruit fly is hovering over the bowl of ripe bananas.
examples.target: 一隻果蠅正在熟透的香蕉碗上面飛來飛去。

examples.source: Please cover the fruit so that no fruit fly can land.
examples.target: 請把水果蓋好，以免果蠅飛上去。

examples.source: If you leave food out, a fruit fly might appear quickly.
examples.target: 如果你把食物放在外面，果蠅很快就會出現。

examples.source: It can frustrate me when I cannot finish my homework.
examples.target: 當我無法完成功課時，這會令我感到沮喪。

examples.source: The difficult math problems really frustrate many students in class.
examples.target: 這些困難的數學題真的令班上許多學生感到沮喪。

examples.source: He felt frustrated because he lost the game again today.
examples.target: 他今天又輸了比賽，所以感到很沮喪。

examples.source: My mother uses the air fryer to cook crispy chicken wings.
examples.target: 我媽媽用氣炸鍋來煮香脆的雞翼。

examples.source: Please turn off the deep fryer after you finish cooking chips.
examples.target: 煮完薯條後，請記得關掉油炸鍋。

examples.source: The new fryer is very easy to clean after every use.
examples.target: 這個新炸鍋每次用完都非常容易清洗。

examples.source: Many people like to visit Fukushima for its beautiful scenery.
examples.target: 很多人喜歡去福島，因為那裡的風景很美。

examples.source: We learned about the geography of Fukushima in our geography lesson.
examples.target: 我們在地理課上學到了關於福島的地理知識。

examples.source: If you go to Fukushima, you should try their local fruit.
examples.target: 如果你去福島的話，應該試試當地的水果。

full access.meaning: 全面使用權 / 完整進入權限

examples.source: Students have full access to the library during lunch time.
examples.target: 午飯時間，學生可以使用圖書館的所有設施。

examples.source: You need a password to get full access to the files.
examples.target: 你需要密碼才能獲得這些檔案的完整存取權限。

examples.source: The staff member has full access to the school computer system.
examples.target: 該職員擁有學校電腦系統的全面使用權。

examples.source: The stadium is at full capacity for the big concert tonight.
examples.target: 今晚的大型演唱會，體育館已經滿座了。

examples.source: The hospital is at full capacity because of the flu season.
examples.target: 因為流感季節的關係，醫院已經達到容量上限。

examples.source: Our car is at full capacity with five people inside it.
examples.target: 車內坐了五個人，已經達到滿載狀態。

examples.source: I feel much better after a full night's sleep.
examples.target: 經過一整晚充足睡眠後，我感覺好多了。

examples.source: You need a full night's sleep before your exam.
examples.target: 考試前你需要有一整晚充足睡眠。

examples.source: She works hard when she gets a full night's sleep.
examples.target: 當她有一整晚充足睡眠時，工作會更努力。

examples.source: Our shop offers a full range of school stationery for students.
examples.target: 我們店舖提供全系列的學生文具。

examples.source: You can find a full range of healthy snacks in this supermarket.
examples.target: 你可以在這間超級市場找到全套的健康零食。

examples.source: The library has a full range of books if you like reading.
examples.target: 如果你喜歡閱讀，圖書館有全系列的書籍。

examples.source: This shop offers a full range of goods for students.
examples.target: 這間店舖為學生提供全系列貨品。

examples.source: You can find a full range of goods if you visit the supermarket.
examples.target: 如果你去超級市場，就能找到全系列貨品。

examples.source: The new store carries a full range of goods for our daily needs.
examples.target: 這間新店舖售賣滿足我們日常所需的全系列貨品。

examples.source: I cannot run fast because I have a full stomach.
examples.target: 因為我吃得太飽，所以跑不快。

examples.source: It is hard to study well with a full stomach.
examples.target: 吃飽之後很難專心讀書。

examples.source: You should rest for a while after having a full stomach.
examples.target: 吃飽之後，你應該休息一會兒。

full supervision.meaning: 全程監督 / 全面看管

examples.source: The young children need full supervision when they play outside.
examples.target: 年幼的孩子在戶外玩耍時，需要全程監督。

examples.source: He is under full supervision because he is a new employee.
examples.target: 因為他是新員工，所以他正在全面監督下工作。

examples.source: The science experiment requires full supervision for everyone's safety.
examples.target: 為了大家的安全，進行科學實驗時需要全程監督。

examples.source: She does a full-body workout at the gym every Saturday morning.
examples.target: 她每個星期六早上都會在健身室進行全身運動。

examples.source: The doctor gave him a full-body checkup to ensure he is healthy.
examples.target: 醫生為他進行了全身檢查，以確保他身體健康。

examples.source: You should wear a full-body swimsuit when you go swimming outdoors.
examples.target: 當你在戶外游泳時，應該穿著全身式的泳衣。

full-length album.meaning: 完整專輯 / 長篇專輯

examples.source: The band just released their first full-length album this week.
examples.target: 這隊樂隊這星期剛發行了他們的首張完整專輯。

examples.source: I bought a full-length album because I love their music.
examples.target: 因為我很喜歡他們的音樂，所以我買了這張完整專輯。

examples.source: He is working hard to record a new full-length album.
examples.target: 他正努力錄製一張全新的完整專輯。

examples.source: We eat mooncakes with our family during the full-moon festival.
examples.target: 我們在滿月節時會與家人一起吃月餅。

examples.source: Children play with colorful lanterns when the full-moon festival arrives.
examples.target: 當滿月節來臨時，小朋友會玩色彩繽紛的燈籠。

examples.source: The moon looks very bright because it is the full-moon festival.
examples.target: 因為今天是滿月節，所以月亮看起來非常明亮。

examples.source: She is looking for full-time employment after she graduates from university.
examples.target: 她在大學畢業後正在尋找全職工作。

examples.source: It is hard to find full-time employment if you have no experience.
examples.target: 如果你沒有經驗，就很難找到全職工作。

examples.source: He decided to leave his part-time job to seek full-time employment.
examples.target: 他決定辭去兼職工作，去尋求全職工作。

fullest.meaning: 最充分的 / 最大程度的

examples.source: We should enjoy our school life to the fullest every day.
examples.target: 我們每天都應該盡情享受校園生活。

examples.source: She gave her fullest effort to finish the difficult project today.
examples.target: 她今天用盡全力完成了這個困難的項目。

examples.source: You should live your life to the fullest when you are young.
examples.target: 你年輕的時候應該活得精彩，不留遺憾。

examples.source: Our school library is fully equipped with many new computers.
examples.target: 我們學校的圖書館設備齊全，有很多新電腦。

examples.source: The hotel room is fully equipped so we can cook there.
examples.target: 這間酒店房間設備齊全，所以我們可以在那裡煮食。

examples.source: The gym is fully equipped for students to exercise after school.
examples.target: 這間健身室設備齊全，方便學生放學後運動。

examples.source: The teacher made the history lesson fun and engaging for everyone.
examples.target: 老師讓歷史課變得既有趣又吸引人。

examples.source: We played some fun and engaging games during the school picnic.
examples.target: 我們在學校旅行時玩了一些有趣又吸引人的遊戲。

examples.source: This science project is fun and engaging because we learn by doing.
examples.target: 這個科學專題研習既有趣又吸引人，因為我們可以從實踐中學習。

examples.source: We joined a fund-raising event to help the local animal shelter.
examples.target: 我們參加了一個籌款活動，去幫助當地的動物收容所。

examples.source: The school organized a fund-raising concert for the new library.
examples.target: 學校為新圖書館舉辦了一場籌款音樂會。

examples.source: She is busy with the fund-raising project for the charity.
examples.target: 她正忙於為慈善機構進行籌款計劃。

fund-raising campaign.meaning: 籌款活動 / 籌款運動

examples.source: Our school is holding a fund-raising campaign for charity.
examples.target: 我們學校正在舉辦一場慈善籌款活動。

examples.source: We joined a fund-raising campaign to help the local hospital.
examples.target: 我們參加了一個籌款活動來幫助當地的醫院。

examples.source: The fund-raising campaign was successful because many students donated money.
examples.target: 這次籌款活動很成功，因為很多學生都捐了錢。

examples.source: The fund-raising officer organized a charity walk to help the school.
examples.target: 籌款主任舉辦了一場慈善步行活動來幫助學校。

examples.source: If you want to donate, please contact our fund-raising officer today.
examples.target: 如果你想捐款，請今天聯絡我們的籌款主任。

examples.source: Our fund-raising officer works hard because we need money for books.
examples.target: 我們的籌款主任工作很努力，因為我們需要錢買書。

examples.source: Education is a fundamental right for every child in school.
examples.target: 受教育是每一位在校學童的基本權利。

examples.source: Everyone has the fundamental right to express their own ideas.
examples.target: 每個人都有表達自己想法的基本權利。

examples.source: We must protect the fundamental right to live in peace.
examples.target: 我們必須保護和平生活的基本權利。

funding application form.meaning: 撥款申請表 / 資助申請表

examples.source: Please complete the funding application form by next Friday.
examples.target: 請在下星期五前填妥這份撥款申請表。

examples.source: I need to sign the funding application form for our club.
examples.target: 我需要為我們的學會簽署這份資助申請表。

examples.source: If you need money, you must submit a funding application form.
examples.target: 如果你需要資金，就必須遞交一份撥款申請表。

funding details.meaning: 撥款詳情 / 資金用途詳情

examples.source: Please check the funding details before you start the project.
examples.target: 請在開始項目之前查看撥款詳情。

examples.source: We need to discuss the funding details if we want more money.
examples.target: 如果我們想要更多資金，就需要討論撥款詳情。

examples.source: The committee will review the funding details at the next meeting.
examples.target: 委員會將在下次會議上審閱撥款詳情。

examples.source: Our school is holding a fundraiser to help the local library.
examples.target: 我們學校正在舉辦一場籌款活動，以幫助當地的圖書館。

examples.source: We raised a lot of money at the charity fundraiser yesterday.
examples.target: 我們在昨天的慈善籌款活動中籌集了很多錢。

examples.source: Please join our fundraiser if you want to support the animals.
examples.target: 如果你想支持這些動物，請參加我們的籌款活動。

examples.source: Our school will hold a fundraising activity for charity next month.
examples.target: 我們學校下個月會舉辦一個慈善籌款活動。

examples.source: We joined a fundraising activity to help the local animal shelter.
examples.target: 我們參加了一個籌款活動，去幫助當地的動物收容所。

examples.source: If we organize a fundraising activity, we can buy new books.
examples.target: 如果我們舉辦一個籌款活動，就可以買新書。

fundraising effort.meaning: 籌款工作 / 籌款努力

examples.source: The school started a fundraising effort to buy new sports equipment.
examples.target: 學校發起了一項籌款工作，用來購買新的運動器材。

examples.source: We joined the fundraising effort because we wanted to help others.
examples.target: 我們加入了這次的籌款努力，因為我們想幫助其他人。

examples.source: If the fundraising effort succeeds, we can build a new library.
examples.target: 如果這次的籌款工作成功，我們就能興建一座新圖書館。

examples.source: The wooden furniture frame is strong enough to hold the sofa.
examples.target: 這個木製家具框架夠堅固，足以支撐整張沙發。

examples.source: We need to check the furniture frame if it is broken.
examples.target: 如果家具框架壞了，我們需要檢查一下。

examples.source: The designer built a metal furniture frame for the new chair.
examples.target: 設計師為這張新椅子製作了一個金屬家具框架。

examples.source: I love playing with my cat because it is very furry.
examples.target: 我喜歡和我的貓玩，因為牠毛茸茸的。

examples.source: The furry dog ran across the park to catch the ball.
examples.target: 那隻毛茸茸的狗跑過公園去接球。

examples.source: My new sweater is soft and furry, so it feels warm.
examples.target: 我的新毛衣又柔軟又毛茸茸，穿起來很暖。

examples.source: He plans to go abroad for further studies after graduation.
examples.target: 他打算畢業後到外國升學。

examples.source: She is considering further studies to improve her career prospects.
examples.target: 她正在考慮進修，以提升自己的事業前景。

examples.source: If you want a better job, you should consider further studies.
examples.target: 如果你想找一份更好的工作，就應該考慮進修。

examples.source: My little brother is very fussy about what he eats.
examples.target: 我弟弟對吃東西非常挑剔。

examples.source: She is a fussy person who likes everything perfectly clean.
examples.target: 她是一個很挑剔的人，喜歡每樣東西都乾乾淨淨。

examples.source: Don't be so fussy if you want to finish dinner quickly.
examples.target: 如果你想快點吃完晚飯，就不要那麼挑剔。

examples.source: You should dress neatly to impress your future employer.
examples.target: 你應該穿著整潔，給你的未來僱主留下好印象。

examples.source: I want to gain more work experience for my future employer.
examples.target: 我想累積更多工作經驗，為我的未來僱主做好準備。

examples.target: 選舉前，廣場上充滿政治激情。

fest.meaning: 節慶活動 / 大量...的活動

examples.target: 美食節吸引了許多家庭。

examples.target: 沒有人討論那次分歧後，問題開始惡化。

examples.target: 老師不應讓欺凌在班中惡化。

examples.source: Do not fall into a trap set by online scammers.
examples.target: 不要墮入網上騙子的陷阱。

examples.source: The hero nearly fell into a trap.
examples.target: 主角差點墮入陷阱。

examples.source: Careless readers may fall into a trap in this question.
examples.target: 粗心讀者可能會墮入這條題目的陷阱。

examples.source: He fell into debt after spending too much.
examples.target: 他因花費太多而陷入債務。

examples.source: The lesson teaches students not to fall into debt.
examples.target: 這課教學生不要欠債。

examples.source: Many small shops fell into debt during the crisis.
examples.target: 危機期間，很多小店陷入債務。

examples.source: The secret file must not fall into the wrong hands.
examples.target: 秘密文件不可落入壞人手中。

examples.source: If the phone falls into someone's hands, change your password.
examples.target: 如果手機落入某人手中，就更改密碼。

examples.source: The map fell into the enemy's hands in the story.
examples.target: 故事中，地圖落入敵人手中。

examples.source: Do not fall into the trap of clicking unknown links.
examples.target: 不要跌入點擊不明連結的陷阱。

examples.source: The detective knew he might fall into the trap.
examples.target: 偵探知道自己可能會中計。

examples.source: Many students fall into the trap of answering too quickly.
examples.target: 很多學生跌入太快作答的陷阱。

examples.source: She felt spied on when the camera followed her.
examples.target: 攝影機跟著她時，她感到被監視。

examples.source: Some users feel spied on by tracking apps.
examples.target: 有些用戶覺得被追蹤應用程式監視。

examples.source: Students may feel spied on if rules are not explained.
examples.target: 如果規則沒有解釋清楚，學生可能會感到被監視。

fight for survival.meaning: 求生之戰 / 生存搏鬥

examples.source: The documentary shows the animals' fight for survival.
examples.target: 紀錄片展示動物的求生之戰。

examples.source: After the storm, the village faced a fight for survival.
examples.target: 暴風後，村莊面對生存搏鬥。

examples.source: The novel describes a family's fight for survival.
examples.target: 小說描寫一個家庭的求生之戰。

examples.source: The doctor arranged a follow-up consultation next week.
examples.target: 醫生安排下星期覆診。

examples.source: A follow-up consultation helps check recovery.
examples.target: 跟進診症有助檢查康復情況。

examples.source: Please bring the report to your follow-up consultation.
examples.target: 請帶報告去覆診。

examples.source: The story warned that hikers could freeze to death in the storm.
examples.target: 故事警告行山者可能在暴風雪中凍死。

examples.source: Rescuers arrived before anyone froze to death.
examples.target: 救援人員在任何人凍死前到達。

examples.source: Animals need shelter so they do not freeze to death.
examples.target: 動物需要庇護處，才不會凍死。

fade into obscurity.meaning: 逐漸被遺忘 / 變得無人知曉

examples.source: The old song slowly faded into obscurity.
examples.target: 那首舊歌慢慢被遺忘。

examples.source: Without support, the project faded into obscurity.
examples.target: 沒有支持，項目逐漸變得無人知曉。

examples.source: Some inventions fade into obscurity after a few years.
examples.target: 有些發明幾年後逐漸被遺忘。

examples.source: Her fear fell away after the first question.
examples.target: 第一條問題後，她的恐懼消失了。

examples.source: Support may fall away if people lose trust.
examples.target: 如果人們失去信任，支持可能逐漸減弱。

examples.source: The noise fell away as we entered the library.
examples.target: 我們進入圖書館時，噪音逐漸消失。

fall on hard times.meaning: 陷入困境 / 經濟困難

examples.source: The family fell on hard times after the shop closed.
examples.target: 店舖結業後，這個家庭陷入經濟困難。

examples.source: Many small businesses fell on hard times during the crisis.
examples.target: 危機期間，很多小生意陷入困境。

examples.source: The club fell on hard times when members left.
examples.target: 會員離開後，學會陷入困境。

examples.source: The final decision fell on the principal's shoulders.
examples.target: 最終決定的責任落在校長身上。

examples.source: Much of the work fell on her shoulders.
examples.target: 大部分工作責任落在她身上。

examples.source: When the leader left, the task fell on my shoulders.
examples.target: 領袖離開後，任務責任落在我身上。

fall through the net.meaning: 被制度遺漏 / 得不到應有幫助

examples.source: Some students fall through the net without early support.
examples.target: 沒有早期支援，有些學生會被制度遺漏。

examples.source: The charity helps families who fall through the net.
examples.target: 慈善機構幫助得不到應有幫助的家庭。

examples.source: Better records can stop people from falling through the net.
examples.target: 更好的紀錄可以避免人們被制度遺漏。

examples.source: The audience fell under the singer's spell.
examples.target: 觀眾被歌手吸引住。

examples.source: Many readers fall under the story's spell.
examples.target: 很多讀者著迷於這個故事。

examples.source: He fell under the city's spell during the trip.
examples.target: 旅程期間，他被這個城市吸引住。

examples.source: The students fanned out to search the playground.
examples.target: 學生散開去搜索操場。

examples.source: The cards fanned out on the table.
examples.target: 卡牌在桌上扇形展開。

examples.source: Reporters fanned out across the city.
examples.target: 記者在城市各處散開。

far cry from.meaning: 與...大相逕庭 / 完全不同

examples.source: The final result was a far cry from our first plan.
examples.target: 最終結果與我們最初計劃大相逕庭。

examples.source: This quiet village is a far cry from the busy city.
examples.target: 這個寧靜村莊與繁忙城市完全不同。

examples.source: His new writing is a far cry from his old style.
examples.target: 他的新寫作與舊風格大相逕庭。

far from a given.meaning: 並非必然的 / 未必一定有的

examples.source: Success is far from a given in this competition.
examples.target: 在這場比賽中，成功並非必然。

examples.source: A high score is far from a given without practice.
examples.target: 沒有練習，高分未必一定有。

examples.source: Support from everyone is far from a given.
examples.target: 得到所有人的支持並非必然。

far from guaranteed.meaning: 絕非保證的 / 並不一定會成功的

examples.source: Victory is far from guaranteed.
examples.target: 勝利絕非保證的。

examples.source: The plan is promising, but success is far from guaranteed.
examples.target: 計劃有希望，但成功並不一定。

examples.source: A place in the final is far from guaranteed.
examples.target: 進入決賽絕非保證的。

examples.source: The flower market was a feast for the senses.
examples.target: 花市是一場感官盛宴。

examples.source: The food festival became a feast for the senses.
examples.target: 美食節成為一場感官盛宴。

examples.source: The concert was a feast for the senses.
examples.target: 音樂會是一場感官盛宴。

feast one's eyes on.meaning: 大飽眼福 / 盡情欣賞

examples.source: Tourists feasted their eyes on the harbour view.
examples.target: 遊客盡情欣賞海港景色。

examples.source: We feasted our eyes on the colourful lanterns.
examples.target: 我們看著色彩繽紛的燈籠，大飽眼福。

examples.source: She feasted her eyes on the paintings in the gallery.
examples.target: 她在畫廊盡情欣賞畫作。

feel it in one's bones.meaning: 深深感受到 / 憑直覺感到

examples.source: I felt it in my bones that the test would be hard.
examples.target: 我憑直覺感到測驗會很難。

examples.source: She felt it in her bones that change was coming.
examples.target: 她深深感受到改變快要來臨。

examples.source: He felt it in his bones that the team could win.
examples.target: 他憑直覺感到隊伍可以勝出。

fend for itself.meaning: 自力更生 / 自行生存

examples.source: The young animal had to fend for itself.
examples.target: 這隻幼小動物要自行生存。

examples.source: The small shop learned to fend for itself.
examples.target: 小店學會自力更生。

examples.source: Without help, the club had to fend for itself.
examples.target: 沒有幫助，學會只好自力更生。

fend for oneself.meaning: 照顧自己 / 自力更生

examples.source: Students learn to fend for themselves on study trips.
examples.target: 學生在遊學中學會照顧自己。

examples.source: After moving out, he had to fend for himself.
examples.target: 搬出去後，他要自力更生。

examples.source: The course teaches teenagers how to fend for themselves.
examples.target: 課程教青少年如何照顧自己。

fight one's way through.meaning: 艱難地穿過 / 奮力通過

examples.source: We fought our way through the crowded station.
examples.target: 我們艱難地穿過擠迫的車站。

examples.source: She fought her way through the difficult chapter.
examples.target: 她奮力讀完困難的一章。

examples.source: The hikers fought their way through heavy rain.
examples.target: 行山人士在大雨中艱難前進。

fill someone with horror.meaning: 令某人感到恐懼 / 驚駭

examples.source: The news filled the villagers with horror.
examples.target: 這則消息令村民感到驚駭。

examples.source: The thought of losing the files filled me with horror.
examples.target: 想到會遺失檔案，我感到恐懼。

examples.source: The scene in the novel filled readers with horror.
examples.target: 小說中的場面令讀者感到驚駭。

final nail in the coffin.meaning: 致命一擊 / 最後一根稻草

examples.source: The rent increase was the final nail in the coffin for the shop.
examples.target: 租金上升成為那間店的致命一擊。

examples.source: The missed deadline was the final nail in the coffin.
examples.target: 錯過截止日期是最後一根稻草。

examples.source: Bad reviews became the final nail in the coffin for the film.
examples.target: 差評成為這部電影的致命一擊。

fit for public consumption.meaning: 適合公開給大眾觀看的

examples.source: The report was not fit for public consumption yet.
examples.target: 報告尚未適合公開給大眾觀看。

examples.source: The video must be checked before it is fit for public consumption.
examples.target: 影片公開給大眾觀看前必須先檢查。

examples.source: The final version is now fit for public consumption.
examples.target: 最終版本現在適合公開給大眾觀看。

examples.source: The job did not fit with her values.
examples.target: 這份工作不符合她的價值觀。

examples.source: Choose a school that fits with your values.
examples.target: 選擇一間符合你價值觀的學校。

examples.source: His decision fits with his values about fairness.
examples.target: 他的決定符合他重視公平的價值觀。

examples.source: The teacher flagged up a common mistake.
examples.target: 老師指出一個常見錯誤。

examples.source: Please flag up any problem before the deadline.
examples.target: 請在截止日期前提醒注意任何問題。

examples.source: The report flags up the need for cleaner transport.
examples.target: 報告指出需要更潔淨的交通。

examples.source: The argument flared up during the meeting.
examples.target: 爭論在會議期間突然爆發。

examples.source: Her old injury flared up after the race.
examples.target: 比賽後，她的舊患加劇。

examples.source: Tension can flare up when people feel ignored.
examples.target: 當人們覺得被忽視時，緊張氣氛可能突然加劇。

examples.source: The horse crossed the field at a flat-out gallop.
examples.target: 馬全速奔馳穿過田野。

examples.source: The film shows a dramatic flat-out gallop.
examples.target: 電影展示了一場戲劇性的全速奔馳。

examples.source: A flat-out gallop requires strength and control.
examples.target: 全速奔馳需要力量和控制。

flesh out.meaning: 充實內容 / 加入細節

examples.source: You should flesh out this paragraph with examples.
examples.target: 你應該用例子充實這段內容。

examples.source: The writer fleshed out the main character.
examples.target: 作者為主角加入更多細節。

examples.source: We need to flesh out the plan before Friday.
examples.target: 星期五前，我們需要充實計劃內容。

flies in the ointment.meaning: 美中不足之處 / 掃興的問題

examples.source: The only flies in the ointment were the long queues.
examples.target: 唯一美中不足之處是長長的人龍。

examples.source: There were a few flies in the ointment during the trip.
examples.target: 旅程中有幾個掃興的問題。

examples.source: The price and the noise were flies in the ointment.
examples.target: 價錢和噪音是美中不足之處。

float one's boat.meaning: 令某人感興趣 / 合某人口味

examples.source: If science does not float your boat, try history.
examples.target: 如果科學不合你口味，試試歷史。

examples.source: This kind of music really floats her boat.
examples.target: 這種音樂真的令她感興趣。

examples.source: Choose a hobby that floats your boat.
examples.target: 選一個令你感興趣的嗜好。

examples.source: The character flew into a rage when he heard the lie.
examples.target: 角色聽到謊言後勃然大怒。

examples.source: She did not fly into a rage; she stayed calm.
examples.target: 她沒有勃然大怒，而是保持冷靜。

examples.source: The novel shows how quickly he can fly into a rage.
examples.target: 小說展示他可以多快勃然大怒。

examples.source: The announcement followed on the heels of the meeting.
examples.target: 公布緊接在會議之後。

examples.source: Heavy rain followed on the heels of strong winds.
examples.target: 大雨緊接在強風之後。

examples.source: The new rule followed on the heels of several complaints.
examples.target: 新規則緊接在幾宗投訴之後。

examples.source: She followed her talent and became a designer.
examples.target: 她按自己的才能發展，成為設計師。

examples.source: Teachers should help students follow their talent.
examples.target: 老師應幫助學生按自己的才能發展。

examples.source: He chose to follow his talent in music.
examples.target: 他選擇按自己在音樂方面的才能發展。

examples.source: The promise seemed to last for all eternity.
examples.target: 這個承諾似乎會永遠持續。

examples.source: No school rule should remain unchanged for all eternity.
examples.target: 沒有校規應該永久不變。

examples.source: The story says their friendship lasted for all eternity.
examples.target: 故事說他們的友誼永遠持續。

for all the wrong reasons.meaning: 因負面原因 / 因不光彩原因

examples.source: The video became famous for all the wrong reasons.
examples.target: 影片因負面原因而出名。

examples.source: The policy attracted attention for all the wrong reasons.
examples.target: 政策因不光彩原因受到關注。

examples.source: He was remembered for all the wrong reasons.
examples.target: 他因負面原因被人記住。

for better or for worse.meaning: 不論好壞 / 無論結果如何

examples.source: For better or for worse, the decision has been made.
examples.target: 不論好壞，決定已經作出。

examples.source: Technology has changed learning, for better or for worse.
examples.target: 科技不論好壞都改變了學習。

examples.source: For better or for worse, we must finish the project today.
examples.target: 無論結果如何，我們今天必須完成項目。

examples.source: He held on to the rail for dear life.
examples.target: 他死命抓住欄杆。

examples.source: The child ran for dear life in the game.
examples.target: 孩子在遊戲中拚命地跑。

examples.source: She clung to her notes for dear life before the speech.
examples.target: 演說前，她死命抓住筆記。

examples.source: He spoke softly for fear that he would wake the baby.
examples.target: 他小聲說話，因為擔心會吵醒嬰兒。

examples.source: She saved the file twice for fear that it might disappear.
examples.target: 她儲存檔案兩次，以免檔案消失。

examples.source: They left early for fear that traffic would be heavy.
examples.target: 他們提早離開，因為擔心交通擠塞。

for its own sake.meaning: 為了事情本身 / 不是為了其他目的

examples.source: She reads for its own sake, not for marks.
examples.target: 她閱讀是為了閱讀本身，不是為了分數。

examples.source: Art can be enjoyed for its own sake.
examples.target: 藝術可以為了本身而欣賞。

examples.source: Do not add technology for its own sake.
examples.target: 不要為了科技本身而加入科技。

examples.source: I do not like the plan, or the backup plan for that matter.
examples.target: 我不喜歡這個計劃；說起來，後備計劃我也不喜歡。

examples.source: No one asked me, or the students for that matter.
examples.target: 沒有人問我；就此而言，也沒有人問學生。

examples.source: The rule is unfair to teachers and, for that matter, parents.
examples.target: 這規則對老師不公平；就此而言，對家長也不公平。

for the best part of.meaning: 差不多 / 接近（某段時間）

examples.source: We waited for the best part of an hour.
examples.target: 我們等了差不多一小時。

examples.source: She studied for the best part of the afternoon.
examples.target: 她溫習了差不多整個下午。

examples.source: The meeting lasted for the best part of two hours.
examples.target: 會議持續了接近兩小時。

for the history books.meaning: 值得載入史冊的 / 歷史性的重要

examples.source: The victory was one for the history books.
examples.target: 這場勝利值得載入史冊。

examples.source: Her discovery was for the history books.
examples.target: 她的發現具有歷史性的重要。

examples.source: It was a performance for the history books.
examples.target: 這是一場值得載入史冊的表演。

for the life of me.meaning: 怎樣也 / 無論如何也

examples.source: For the life of me, I cannot remember his name.
examples.target: 我怎樣也想不起他的名字。

examples.source: She could not, for the life of her, solve the riddle.
examples.target: 她無論如何也解不開謎題。

examples.source: For the life of me, I do not understand this joke.
examples.target: 我怎樣也不明白這個笑話。

examples.source: The course is useful for the likes of young writers.
examples.target: 這課程對年輕作家這類人來說很有用。

examples.source: This tool is not designed for the likes of beginners.
examples.target: 這工具不是為初學者這類人設計的。

examples.source: The fee is too high for the likes of ordinary students.
examples.target: 對普通學生這類人來說，費用太高。

force for good.meaning: 正面力量 / 促進好事的力量

examples.source: Education can be a force for good.
examples.target: 教育可以是一股正面力量。

examples.source: The club became a force for good in the community.
examples.target: 學會成為社區中促進好事的力量。

examples.source: Technology should be used as a force for good.
examples.target: 科技應被用作正面力量。

examples.source: The deadline forced the manager's hand.
examples.target: 截止日期迫使經理行動。

examples.source: Public pressure forced the school's hand.
examples.target: 公眾壓力迫使學校行動。

examples.source: The sudden problem forced her hand.
examples.target: 突如其來的問題迫使她行動。

examples.source: The young team became a force to be reckoned with.
examples.target: 這支年輕隊伍成為不可忽視的力量。

examples.source: Online learning is now a force to be reckoned with.
examples.target: 網上學習現在是不可忽視的力量。

examples.source: She is a force to be reckoned with in debate.
examples.target: 她在辯論方面是不可忽視的力量。

examples.source: We had to fork over extra money for delivery.
examples.target: 我們要為送貨掏額外的錢。

examples.source: He refused to fork over the full fee.
examples.target: 他拒絕付出全額費用。

examples.source: Parents often fork over a lot for textbooks.
examples.target: 家長經常要為課本掏很多錢。

freaked-out.meaning: 極度激動的 / 嚇壞的

examples.source: The student looked freaked-out before the speech.
examples.target: 演說前，學生看起來嚇壞了。

examples.source: Do not make a decision when you are freaked-out.
examples.target: 極度激動時不要作決定。

examples.source: She was freaked-out by the sudden noise.
examples.target: 她被突如其來的聲音嚇壞了。

free-for-all.meaning: 人人都可隨意參與的混亂局面

examples.source: The discussion became a noisy free-for-all.
examples.target: 討論變成人人都可隨意發言的混亂局面。

examples.source: Without rules, the game turned into a free-for-all.
examples.target: 沒有規則，遊戲變成混亂局面。

examples.source: The sale was a free-for-all after the doors opened.
examples.target: 開門後，減價活動變成人人爭搶的混亂局面。

examples.source: She joined the interview fresh off a major win.
examples.target: 她剛取得重大勝利後就參加訪問。

examples.source: The team was fresh off a difficult match.
examples.target: 隊伍剛完成一場困難比賽。

examples.source: He returned to class fresh off the exam.
examples.target: 他剛結束考試便回到課室。

examples.source: Do not fret over one small mistake.
examples.target: 不要為一個小錯誤擔心。

examples.source: She fretted over the exam result all weekend.
examples.target: 她整個週末都為考試結果憂慮。

examples.source: Parents often fret over their children's future.
examples.target: 家長經常擔心子女的未來。

examples.source: From a practical perspective, the plan is too expensive.
examples.target: 從實際角度來看，計劃太昂貴。

examples.source: From a practical perspective, online forms save time.
examples.target: 從實際角度來看，網上表格節省時間。

examples.source: From a practical perspective, we need a smaller classroom.
examples.target: 從實際角度來看，我們需要較小的課室。

examples.source: The article describes a journey from calamity to commercial enterprise.
examples.target: 文章描述一段從災難走向商業事業的歷程。

examples.source: The business grew from calamity to commercial enterprise.
examples.target: 這門生意從災難走向商業事業。

examples.source: The case study shows how a town moved from calamity to commercial enterprise.
examples.target: 個案研究展示一個小鎮如何從災難走向商業事業。

from many quarters.meaning: 來自多方面 / 來自各方

examples.source: Support came from many quarters.
examples.target: 支持來自各方。

examples.source: The plan received criticism from many quarters.
examples.target: 計劃受到多方面批評。

examples.source: Ideas from many quarters helped improve the project.
examples.target: 來自各方的想法幫助改善項目。

examples.source: From the sound of things, the meeting went well.
examples.target: 聽起來，會議進行得不錯。

examples.source: From the sound of things, she enjoyed the trip.
examples.target: 從情況看，她很享受旅程。

examples.source: From the sound of things, we need more practice.
examples.target: 聽起來，我們需要更多練習。

examples.source: After months of practice, she enjoyed the fruits of her labour.
examples.target: 經過數月練習，她享受到努力的成果。

examples.source: The exhibition showed the fruits of the students' labour.
examples.target: 展覽展示學生努力的成果。

examples.source: Good results are the fruits of steady labour.
examples.target: 好成績是持續努力的成果。

examples.source: She is fundamentally opposed to unfair rules.
examples.target: 她根本反對不公平規則。

examples.source: The group is fundamentally opposed to wasting resources.
examples.target: 小組根本反對浪費資源。

examples.source: He was fundamentally opposed to the new policy.
examples.target: 他根本反對新政策。

further one's passion.meaning: 進一步發展熱情 / 深入追求興趣

examples.source: She joined the club to further her passion for art.
examples.target: 她加入學會，進一步發展對藝術的熱情。

examples.source: The course helps students further their passion for science.
examples.target: 課程幫助學生深入追求對科學的興趣。

examples.source: He moved overseas to further his passion for music.
examples.target: 他到海外進一步發展對音樂的熱情。
